plan: irq_ctrl
spec: interface_spec.md
requirements:
  - id: IRQ-PARAM
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "The block works for every `N` from 2 to 32, and bits `N` and up of the `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` registers read as zero and ignore writes."
  - id: IRQ-RESET
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` clear to zero and the remembered level of every source clears to zero."
  - id: IRQ-REG-RW
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A write to `ENABLE` or `MODE` stores `wdata` bits `N-1` to 0 in that register."
  - id: IRQ-READ
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."
  - id: IRQ-LEVEL
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A high-level source sets its `PENDING` bit at every rising edge where its input is high."
  - id: IRQ-EDGE
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A rising-edge source sets its `PENDING` bit at a rising edge where its input is high and was low at the previous rising edge, so an input held high sets it once."
  - id: IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "Detection does not depend on `ENABLE`: a disabled source still sets its `PENDING` bit."
  - id: IRQ-W1C
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A write to `PENDING` clears each bit written 1 and leaves each bit written 0 unchanged; it never sets a bit."
  - id: IRQ-ACK
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A write to `CLAIM` acknowledges the source whose number is in `wdata` bits 4 to 0: that source's `PENDING` bit clears and no other bit changes; a number of `N` or more changes nothing."
  - id: IRQ-SET-WINS
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A source detected at the same rising edge as a write that clears its bit keeps its `PENDING` bit set, so a high-level source acknowledged while its input is still high stays pending."
  - id: IRQ-MASK
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "`irq` is high exactly when some source has both its `PENDING` and its `ENABLE` bit set, for high-level and rising-edge sources alike."
  - id: IRQ-PRIORITY
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "`irq_id` is the lowest-numbered source whose `PENDING` and `ENABLE` bits are both set, so source 0 has the highest priority, and it is 0 while `irq` is low."
  - id: IRQ-CLAIM
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."
  - id: IRQ-LATENCY
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "`irq` and `irq_id` follow the registers with no clock edge, so a source detected at one rising edge drives `irq` until the next."
items:
  - id: test_reset
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-RESET]
    description: "Stimulus: write all-ones to ENABLE and MODE, raise sources so PENDING is nonzero, hold one edge-mode source high through reset, then assert rst_n low for one or more edges. Check: ENABLE, MODE and PENDING read 0 after reset; the edge-mode source still high after reset sets PENDING at the first edge, which shows its remembered level was cleared to 0."
  - id: test_reg_rw
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-REG-RW, IRQ-PARAM]
    description: "Stimulus: write walking-ones, walking-zeros and random wdata to ENABLE and MODE. Check: readback equals wdata bits N-1..0, and bits N and up read 0."
  - id: test_param_widths
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PARAM]
    description: "Run test_reg_rw, test_level_detect, test_w1c and test_priority with N=2, N=8 and N=32. Check: bits N and up of ENABLE, MODE and PENDING read 0 after all-ones writes and all-ones src, and per-source behaviour holds for the top source N-1."
  - id: test_read_side_effects
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-READ]
    description: "Stimulus: with src held at 0, sweep addr over 0..3 several times, changing addr between edges and within a cycle, with we low. Check: rdata matches the model for the current addr in the same cycle, and no register value changes across the reads, including CLAIM reads."
  - id: test_level_detect
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-LEVEL, IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED]
    description: "Stimulus: MODE=0. Drive each source high for one cycle and for many cycles, with ENABLE both set and clear. Clear PENDING between pulses. Check: PENDING bit sets at the first edge src is high, re-sets at every edge after a W1C while src stays high, and sets the same way when ENABLE is 0."
  - id: test_edge_detect
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-EDGE, IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED]
    description: "Stimulus: MODE=1. Drive 0->1 transitions, hold high for many cycles, and clear PENDING while held high. Repeat with ENABLE 0. Check: PENDING sets only at the edge after a low sample, does not set again while held high after clearing, and detection is independent of ENABLE."
  - id: test_w1c
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-W1C]
    description: "Stimulus: with sources quiet, set a known PENDING pattern, then write random masks to PENDING, including all-zeros and bits that are currently 0. Check: each bit written 1 clears, each bit written 0 keeps its value, and no bit ever goes 0->1 because of the write."
  - id: test_claim_ack
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-ACK, IRQ-CLAIM]
    description: "Stimulus: with sources quiet and several PENDING bits set, write CLAIM with each source number 0..N-1, with numbers N..31, and with nonzero upper wdata bits. Check: only the named source's PENDING bit clears; numbers N or more change nothing; only wdata bits 4..0 select the source; the CLAIM read reflects the new irq/irq_id."
  - id: test_set_wins
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-SET-WINS]
    description: "Stimulus: at the same edge a source is detected (level held high; edge 0->1), write PENDING with that bit 1, and separately write CLAIM with that source number. Check: the PENDING bit is set after the edge in each case; a level source acknowledged while still high stays pending and irq stays high if enabled."
  - id: test_mask
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-MASK]
    description: "Stimulus: sweep ENABLE and PENDING combinations, with sources in both level and edge mode. Check: irq equals OR over i of (PENDING[i] AND ENABLE[i]) in every cycle; pending but disabled sources do not raise irq; enabling an already-pending source raises irq."
  - id: test_priority
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PRIORITY, IRQ-CLAIM]
    description: "Stimulus: set several pending and enabled sources at once, including source 0, source N-1 and disabled lower sources, then acknowledge them one by one. Check: irq_id is the lowest pending and enabled source after each step and 0 when irq is low; the CLAIM read returns irq in bit 31, irq_id in bits 4..0, and zeros elsewhere."
  - id: test_latency
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-LATENCY]
    description: "Stimulus: detect a source at an edge, and change ENABLE or clear PENDING at an edge. Check: irq and irq_id change in the same cycle as the register change, with no extra clock delay, sampled just after the edge and just before the next."
  - id: test_smoke
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-RESET, IRQ-LEVEL, IRQ-MASK, IRQ-CLAIM, IRQ-ACK]
    description: "Stimulus: reset, enable source 1, pulse it, read CLAIM, acknowledge it. Check: irq rises with irq_id 1, the CLAIM read matches, and irq falls after the acknowledge."
  - id: test_random_regress
    kind: test
    file: irq_ctrl_tb.sv
    proves: [IRQ-LEVEL, IRQ-EDGE, IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED, IRQ-W1C, IRQ-ACK, IRQ-SET-WINS, IRQ-MASK, IRQ-PRIORITY, IRQ-CLAIM, IRQ-READ, IRQ-REG-RW]
    description: "Stimulus: constrained-random src, register writes and reads over many seeds, including writes that coincide with detection. Check: a cycle-accurate reference model compares PENDING, rdata, irq and irq_id every cycle."
  - id: a_irq_mask
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-MASK]
    description: "Every cycle: irq == |(PENDING & ENABLE)."
  - id: a_irq_id_priority
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PRIORITY]
    description: "Every cycle: irq_id equals the index of the lowest set bit of PENDING & ENABLE, and irq_id == 0 when irq is low."
  - id: a_claim_format
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-CLAIM]
    description: "When addr == 3: rdata == {irq, 26'b0, irq_id}."
  - id: a_w1c_never_sets
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-W1C]
    description: "On a PENDING write, a bit that goes 0->1 must be explained by detection at that edge; a bit written 0 keeps its value unless detected."
  - id: a_ack_one_bit
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-ACK, IRQ-SET-WINS]
    description: "On a CLAIM write with wdata[4:0] < N, only that bit may clear, and it stays set if detected at the same edge; with wdata[4:0] >= N, PENDING changes only by detection."
  - id: a_edge_once
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-EDGE, IRQ-LEVEL]
    description: "For a rising-edge source, PENDING sets only when src was low at the previous edge and is high now; for a level source, PENDING is set after every edge where src is high."
  - id: a_upper_bits_zero
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PARAM]
    description: "When addr is 0, 1 or 2: rdata bits 31..N are 0."
  - id: a_read_no_change
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-READ, IRQ-REG-RW]
    description: "When we is low, ENABLE and MODE hold their values and PENDING changes only by detection; when we is high and addr is 0 or 1, the register takes wdata bits N-1..0 at the next edge."
  - id: a_comb_outputs
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-LATENCY]
    description: "Every cycle, irq and irq_id are a pure function of the current PENDING and ENABLE values, with no registered delay."
=== END FILE ===
